description.en: The IDs of the activation codes.
The name of the activation code.

description.zh:
激活码状态。取值范围：

- activated：已激活。

- unactivated：未激活。
- expired：已过期。
description.en:
The status of the activation code. Valid values:

- activated: The activation code is activated.

- unactivated: The activation code is not activated.

- expired: The activation code has expired.

descriptions.zh:
查询已创建的激活码以及激活码的使用情况。
激活码的状态包括已激活、未激活和已过期三种。
descriptions.en: An activation code can have one of the following statuses: activated, unactivated, or expired.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc list-access-tokens --access-token-id at-bp1akz2zp67r0k6r0000 --name test_name --status activated --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun smc ListAccessTokens --region cn-hangzhou --Status activated --AccessTokenId.1 'at-bp1akz2zp67r0k6r0000' --Name test_name
